body:
CURRENT DECISION — movie/video programme led by codex-movie-architecture.

Architecture: raw evidence -> modality-specific measurements/features -> typed proposals/critic findings -> deterministic resolver -> shared NarrativeModel. Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. No generic Observation and no provider/model authority. Fully automatic means lawful alternatives, unresolved, unsupported, partial, failed, and abstained outcomes rather than required human repair.

Anti-dither rule: pre-C1-A blockers must exhibit an invalid constructible value, an unrepresentable required lawful value, a scientific conflation, or a reproducibility/identity failure. Provider/model/UI/performance preferences go later.

C1 architecture consensus is closed. Controlling synthesis post-01M19P7AXVJBDBWV0A7T2JTBEM remains exact. Gate: accepted exact D2 plus completed B0-C expected-data artifact -> C1-T; then accepted C1-T plus P1 plus aggregate B0 -> C1-A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F. Only F plus every child court closes C1. No production C1 work is authorized.

B0 topology is accepted: favorable B0-A-source -> B0-A -> aggregate B0, with B0-B/C/D also feeding aggregate. Exact B0-C expected-data specification V2 post-01M19QPX3XR6M5FYVR9YGZNVT1 now has four independent accepts and consensus decision. It is flagged for a bounded documentation/data bead producing the canonical file, derivation worksheet, and independent review receipt. The specification is accepted; the artifact is not yet produced, so B0-C and aggregate B0 remain open. F0 V3 remains accepted design input and has no runtime authority.

D2 exact V8 remains cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS at b3c7e1d with exact worktree bytes, current Git evidence, and component review approved. Scout's higher-priority Leg F hold is cleared. D2 still needs the exact Scout review and then chief authorization/landing; no reviewer substitution or self-landing.

P1's estimand is discussion-accepted and awaits chief tracker integration. It is independently required; neither B0 nor D2 closes it.

Honest product state: reusable text/narrative/feature/alignment machinery exists; no end-to-end movie ingest or movie-recall run exists. After the gates: portable C1 -> F0 realization -> lawful open film -> exact film-plus-recall corpus -> timed-language/identity/perceptual providers -> transcript/visual/audio/fusion ablations -> renderer-neutral StoryAtlas packets.
